traunche.objective: Build and publish the user-approved Broadway-inspired voice audition website with 54 Sunset-rendered recordings and reproducible production code.
scope: Independent repository and static GitHub Pages site
All54 local Kokoro presets recorded on Sunset using agreed passage
Voice cards, gender/accent/language filters, sorting, Play All and Lucky
History, punctuation guide, provenance and installation instructions
Public GitHub repository and Pages publication authorized by user
non_goals: Runtime servers or unrelated host changes

stop_lines.description: Stop for credentials, destructive action, paid services or unrelated machine changes.
stop_lines.threshold: Step exceeds authorized project and isolated Sunset rendering scope

review_gates.name: 54 recordings integrity
expectations: All54 decode with nonzero duration and per-file provenance
Exact approved passage and local host generation
review_gates.evidence: All54 Sunset recordings:31m17s,22581918bytes. Full decode, catalog text/output hashes and unchanged cache resume verified. site/recordings.json.

review_gates.name: Browser behavior
expectations: Filters, sorting, playback, queue, lucky and keyboard controls work
Responsive layout and no browser errors
review_gates.evidence: Four Playwright tests passed in Google Chrome: actual playback, end-driven queue advancement, filters,sort,favorites,lucky,errors,mobile overflow,keyboard and all54 audio URLs. Desktop/mobile screenshots visually inspected.

review_gates.name: Live Pages
expectations: Public URL loads matching published commit and audio plays

evidence_expectations: Automated browser checks and visual inspection
GitHub Pages deployment and live verification

findings.summary: Python basic HTTP preview did not support audio seeking; use standard http-server with byte-range support.

unresolved_risks: English script uses English phonemization for non-English presets; not native-language quality proof
